entity.canonicalSummary: 约公元前2350—前2150年，由萨尔贡及其继承者建立和维持，连接南部美索不达米亚城邦与更广区域的早期王朝政治秩序。

entity.canonicalSummary: 约公元前1894—前1595年，以巴比伦城为中心、在汉谟拉比晚年迅速扩张，又在其继承者时期逐步收缩的第一王朝政治实体。

mesopotamia.scope: Read-only audit; no core files edited. Conservative proposals for coordinator review.

proposals.action: Keep both phases and their approximate touching boundary at -2200. Met explicitly supports late contraction to vicinity of Agade. No need to invent extra phases.
proposals.summary: 萨尔贡及其继承者征服南部城邦，建立了以阿卡德为中心的跨地区王朝。
proposals.rule: 王权通过征服统合各城，继任国王继续维持统治。
proposals.internal: Agade archaeological location unknown; do not assign an exact city coordinate. Summary does not repeat dates. Northern influence is not equivalent to permanent control.

proposals.action: Merge into ur-iii-kingdom-order, -2112..-2004 approximate, southern-mesopotamia core. Remove upper-mesopotamia influence as continuous phase placement until duration is independently established; preserve the supporting source internally. Delete ur-iii-fragmentation and rebind participants/ledger pointers to surviving phase. Do not create a -2028 border-change date from accession alone.
proposals.summary: 以乌尔为王都，重新联结两河南部城邦，以贡赋征集和密集的文书记录组织王国。
proposals.centres: 乌尔；尼普尔是重要宗教中心。
proposals.core: 两河南部的城市与农业腹地。
proposals.rule: 国王依靠贡赋征集与官员网络组织资源，书吏记录物资和劳役。
proposals.internal: Garfinkle chapter abstract verifies unification of Babylonia, tributary economy, patronage and record keeping. Exact territorial withdrawal sequence is not in accessible abstract. Do not add central-mesopotamia controlled solely by interpreting Babylonia broadly.

proposals.action: Strongest minimal correction is one core phase: retain old-babylonian-city-kingdom-emergence, rename title to 以巴比伦为中心的王国, -1894..-1595 approximate, central-mesopotamia core. Remove separate expansion and contraction placements after transferring their sources internally; preserve event-hammurabi-conquests and its chronology as Event evidence. Expansion and later southern resistance can be described in a brief table row without asserting a fabricated exact frontier cutover. If preserving expansion phase is a product requirement, research that phase separately before editing its end date.
proposals.summary: 巴比伦第一王朝在汉谟拉比时期征服多个两河城邦，使巴比伦成为重要的政治中心。
proposals.core: 巴比伦及两河中部地区。
proposals.rule: 国王主持战争、营建和司法，以王室命令与裁判维护统治。
proposals.internal: Current -1749 contraction incorrectly equals accession of successor. Samsuiluna year-name campaigns do not themselves prove all southern land was lost. Do not replace with -1739 mechanically. Dalley 2021 chapter disputes simple devastation/collapse narrative. Existing Podany source points to an entire book, not chapter; verify exact author/chapter before relying on it.

proposals.action: Merge into neo-assyrian-imperial-administration, -911..-609 approximate, upper-mesopotamia core. This is an explicitly conservative core placement; broad western expansion remains in narrative/table evidence rather than false century-long territory states. Remove expansion/collapse phases and migrate references. If full regional shape must be retained, independently review dated region control before adding replacement states; 745 and 631 are not sufficient territorial cutovers.
proposals.summary: 从两河北部兴起，通过战争、行省治理和人口迁徙建立横跨近东的帝国。
proposals.centres: 亚述城、卡尔胡、杜尔沙鲁金与尼尼微先后承担王都职能。
proposals.core: 底格里斯河上游，亚述城至尼尼微一带。
proposals.rule: 国王统领军队与官僚，行省官员、书吏和驿传网络共同管理帝国。
proposals.internal: Met verifies expansion in 8th/7th centuries and attack on Memphis in 671; current -800..-609 contraction is wrong. BM supports gradual collapse following c.631, not instantaneous loss of all western regions at 631. Last Harran stage may be researched via RINAP5/3 rather than derived from a reign boundary.

proposals.action: Keep rise -626..-605 with central-mesopotamia core only; remove upper-mesopotamia controlled from the very first year. Merge western-campaigns into capital-and-rule -605..-539: central-mesopotamia core, southern-levant influence; add syria-northern-levant controlled supported by Met's Gulf-to-Mediterranean empire summary. Do not turn capital reconstruction into separate simultaneous geographical state. Use approximate for -605 territorial transition. Additional southern/upper Mesopotamian placements require separate region mapping review.
proposals.summary: 以巴比伦为首都，击败亚述并向地中海扩张；王室同时大规模重建首都。
proposals.core: 巴比伦及两河下游城市地区。
proposals.rule: 王室通过战争和人口迁移巩固帝国，并以神庙祭仪与营建彰显王权。
proposals.internal: This preserves western reach through the period rather than ending it at 586. Source describes Nebuchadnezzar's empire in sixth century; it does not warrant exact control of every western city starting in 605. southern-levant influence intentionally covers changing vassal/direct control without claiming every place was a province.

phases.title: 以上美索不达米亚为核心
phases.publicDescription: 以上美索不达米亚为核心，逐步恢复力量并向西用兵。
phases.internal: Earlier Syrian tribute and intermittent hegemony omitted rather than depicted as continuous controlled territory from 911.

phases.title: 在叙利亚建立行省
phases.publicDescription: 攻下阿尔帕德，并将北叙利亚的征服地区改设行省。
phases.internal: 740 Arpad conquest/provincialization explicit in Radner ORACC; 738 Hamat NW and Unqu add within same coarse Region, no new phase needed.

phases.title: 控制扩展至南黎凡特
phases.publicDescription: 吞并大马士革和以色列北部，西部行省延伸至米吉多一带。
phases.internal: 732 exact start for Megiddo province. Region controlled means presence in part of Region, not Judah/Moab or every place annexed. c630 exit is rounded approximation: Eshel explicitly 640/630 for Assyrian withdrawal; no claim of a single dated treaty/battle. Alternative scholarship gives630–625. Keep approximation true.

phases.title: 南黎凡特控制收缩
phases.publicDescription: 退出南黎凡特后，仍据两河北部与北叙利亚部分地区。
phases.internal: Broad c630–c612 snapshot; NOT a claim that every Syrian province persisted until612. Direct source for Syria-wide withdrawal exactly612 not found. 614–610 final-war loss interval, 612 approximate editorial divider for collapse of western provincial network and remnant concentration at Harran. Do not remove approximation or assert uniform province-loss year.

phases.title: 退守哈兰一带
phases.publicDescription: 尼尼微陷落后，残余王权在哈兰重整，最终失去据点。
phases.internal: BM Chronicle explicitly Nineveh612, Harran rally, withdrawal610/9 and failed retaking609. Role associated for entire final interval avoids asserting uninterrupted sovereignty in Harran after its capture. Switching core to associated is not sole phase distinction: Syrian Region is removed.

phaseRecommendation.title: 克里特宫殿中心
phaseRecommendation.reason: Met explicitly dates major palace establishments c1900 and widespread destruction c1450. These are a coherent multi-palace network scope. Do not label the post1450 Knossos administration as territorial contraction of a Minoan state. If the parent chooses to include Knossos successor community, retain that separately as localized attestation with a reviewed endpoint, not a generic whole-island late phase. Existing1375 is not established by the opened broad sources; Heraklion municipality gives1350, museum objects1375–1300, so do not silently pick one.

entities.mappingNotes: The administration relation spans1450–1375 and two phases are cited by pending palace rebuilding process. Map former phases to surviving identity only after checking relation temporal constraints; boundary1450 overlap exists, but participant semantics must change from existing living administration to predecessor palace context if scope ends1450.

phaseRecommendation.title: 希腊大陆城市与宫殿
phaseRecommendation.reason: 1600 beginning supported by Met and UNESCO. Cambridge transformation establishes palatial system end c1200. Scope explicitly mainland palace-centred communities, while successor small communities belong to existing greek-dark-age-communities entity. Existing1250 decline boundary and Crete controlled claim not supported by broad sources; c1450 Knossos administration is real but should not imply an empire controlling all Crete. The parent may separately model Crete attestation if retained; do not infer end1250 from loss of local phase references.

entities.mappingNotes: Replace religious relation's two duplicate Mycenaean participants with one surviving palace phase. Reorganization relation becomes transition from palace entity to successor community with boundary1200, or remains a broader historical transition whose source endpoint phase only overlaps start; do not change history solely to satisfy containment.

Existing second stage2000–1300 falsely calls rural reorganization expansion, overlaps mature phase, and puts northwest only in later phase despite Rakhigarhi etc. Do not claim an egalitarian democracy/no rulers as settled fact from Green's interpretation.

entities.mappingNotes: relation-mohenjo-daro-indus-civilization already points surviving core. Pending event-indus-mesopotamia-exchange remains compatible. One geographically stable phase is sufficient; local organization changes remain prose. Cambridge transformation covers1200–1050; Oxford excavations show early Iron Age Lefkandi and eastern imports, project bibliography covers town2100–700. This is region-level aggregate presence, not every named settlement continuous.

phaseRecommendations.action: 建议两阶段：核心统一与下努比亚扩展；移除后期associated假收缩。源文说明努比亚丧失发生在第二中间期，不能以末期文化延续冒充中王国统治阶段。
phaseRecommendations.boundaryEvidence: 约1960来自UCL努比亚页森努塞特一世1956–1911/10修堡。内部注明取世纪近似；nubia父地区过宽，保留influence，详情必须写下努比亚要塞，不写控制整个努比亚。若坚持controlled应新增Lower Nubia region并作为子区。

phaseRecommendations.action: 现1186界是第20王朝起点，非同年失去努比亚、黎凡特。取消该界。UCL明确南黎凡特撤出在拉美西斯四世后，约1145；努比亚控制持续至新王国末。
phaseRecommendations.minimalOptionLimitation: 此三行只修正过早撤出，仍漏掉约1500–1450努比亚扩展。更准确应把第一段1550–1500两核心，新增1500–1450两核心+努比亚controlled；原第二段1450–1145增加南黎凡特influence；第三段1145–1069移除黎凡特。四行每次增删地域，不凑王朝段。1500为图特摩斯一世征服的近似值。

egypt-old-kingdom.summary: 统一王权组织尼罗河流域的资源，建造金字塔与大型王室陵墓。
egypt-old-kingdom.organization: 国王居于统治中心，宫廷官员与地方长官组织各地事务和王室工程。

egypt-middle-kingdom.summary: 底比斯王室重新统一埃及，随后向下努比亚扩展，并迎来文学与艺术的繁荣。
egypt-middle-kingdom.centers: 底比斯；第十二王朝起以伊奇塔维为行政中心。
egypt-middle-kingdom.organization: 王室通过官员和地方统治者治理各地，后期加强中央对地方的掌握。

egypt-new-kingdom.summary: 埃及王权向努比亚与黎凡特扩展，王室以远征、外交和大型神庙连接各地。
egypt-new-kingdom.centers: 底比斯与孟菲斯；阿玛尔纳时期以阿赫塔顿为王都，拉美西斯二世迁都皮拉美西斯。
egypt-new-kingdom.organization: 王室以官员和军队治理埃及及努比亚，并通过属国与驻军维持黎凡特的统治。

western-zhou.summary: 周王室以关中和洛阳为中心，通过封国、册命与祖先祭祀连接黄河中下游的政治中心。
western-zhou.core: 关中渭河流域与洛阳盆地。
western-zhou.organization: 周王授予贵族土地、人口与职事，以宗族关系、朝贡和军事义务联系各地封国。
western-zhou.verification: 首都和黄河范围直接核过Li Feng摘要；册命原馆页仅展览摘要，新正文建议核source-national-museum-ceming全文或用新增香港历史博物馆介绍来源。

shang-civilization.summary: 以王室、城市和祖先祭祀为中心的早期王朝，发展了青铜礼器与甲骨占卜。
shang-civilization.centers: 早期以郑州商城等为中心；晚期王都位于安阳殷墟。
shang-civilization.organization: 商王掌握军事与祭祀权力，通过王室和地方贵族组织各地事务。
